hypothesis: Moving the shared account position cap from six to eight may remove count-caused equity/crypto sleeve capacity mismatch without changing any other risk, strategy, data, or execution rule.
prohibited_variants: No other cap, allocation, strategy, cost, timing, liquidity, lifecycle, or data change; no parameter sweep.

datasets.purpose: crypto hourly scanner history and complete UTC daily strategy bars

period.terminal_rule: Mark remaining holdings at the last causally available price no later than the valuation cutoff; do not force terminal liquidation. Cancel orders without a later eligible fill bar and record them as unfilled; charge costs only for executed fills.
period.before_crypto_available: Crypto sleeve remains cash, subject to actual shared-account cash and exposure rules; do not impute crypto holdings or truncate earlier equity history.
period.selection_basis: Pre-existing canonical equity V3 evaluation window and crypto baseline start, bounded by pinned datasets and next-open settlement; not selected from outcomes.
period.validation: Report 2022-01-03 onward as the pre-existing equity V3 validation partition; there is no independently canonical crypto split, so label this a shared-account diagnostic using the equity boundary. Do not create a new partition after outcomes.

execution.ledger: One account cash, position, order and NAV ledger for both markets; no isolated-run blending or cash transfer.
execution.decision_data: Only causally completed bars and point-in-time universe/lifecycle state. Equity daily labels are New York midnight labels and become available after that session close; crypto UTC daily buckets become available after 24 complete contiguous hours, never at their 00:00 bucket label.
execution.same_timestamp_order: Crypto decision before equity; share one account snapshot, carry executable BUY reservations and unresolved order claims into later decision.
execution.fills: Deterministic next tradable open, sells before dependent buys, with canonical participation/quantity/increment and cash limits; partial fills and nonterminal claims persist until resolved.
execution.broker_failures: Historical OHLCV does not reveal actual broker rejections or failed exits. Test these as predeclared synthetic parity fixtures; do not claim them as observed historical events.
execution.drawdown: Enforce production daily-loss and drawdown entry gates without discretionary operator reset. If an unrecoverable synthetic epoch choice dominates the replay, mark fidelity inconclusive rather than retune.

hard_gates.G1: Only risk.max_positions differs between otherwise byte-identical arm inputs.
hard_gates.G2: Two fresh runs per arm produce byte-identical canonical structural and economic payloads.
hard_gates.G3: Both arms obey unchanged account gross, sleeve, per-name, cash and entry-latch constraints at each relevant event; immutable external inventory is accounted separately.
hard_gates.G4: No new lookahead or changed source, timestamp or PIT semantics.
hard_gates.G5: No production source or configuration change is required to generate results.
hard_gates.G6: Eight-position order, open-order and reconciliation load fits verified published broker mechanics and measured local runtime capabilities; unresolved account-specific entitlement prevents acceptance.
hard_gates.G7: One shared account cash, gross, count, positions, orders and ledger; no synthetic combination.
hard_gates.G8: When actual incumbent demand exceeds six, treatment must demonstrably reduce count-attributable denial/target shortfall. If demand is absent or only a bookkeeping artifact, operational need is unproved. Publish all event dates and magnitudes; do not set a post-outcome cutoff.

decision_rule: Accept only if all G1-G8 pass and no fundamentally unintended risk regime appears. Reject if a hard gate fails or eight does not solve the count-caused issue. Mark inconclusive if replay/data/operational evidence cannot support a safe interpretation. Returns are diagnostics, not an acceptance threshold; no ad hoc numeric non-inferiority rule.
